column1: # Diverse embedding-correctness inputs. Format: id<TAB>group<TAB>text  ('#' = comment).
#  - emit/compare use EVERY row (each x MEAN and LAST pooling).
#  - selfcheck's semantic-sanity uses the `para*` rows as a paraphrase (positive) pair
#    and the `unrel*` rows as an unrelated (negative) pair: para cosine must exceed
#    unrel cosine. Keep >=2 rows in a `para*` group and >=2 in an `unrel*` group.
# Cover short/long, ASCII and non-ASCII/CJK so a scrambled forward pass can't pass by luck.
